about: Evidence: facts = what the IR says of the node; roles = the node's own stack role; uses = a role or tool name of something the node calls. The core processing words a node's PROCESS is said in (src/shared/node_io.ts). Each word names the IR evidence that implies it; a word with no evidence on a node is never said of it. A project may ADD words in .vibegraph/operations.json (never redefine these).

words.label: serves
words.definition: answers calls from outside its own process (routes, a .listen())

words.label: renders
words.definition: draws pages or components for a person

words.label: calls
words.definition: sends a request across a boundary and waits for the answer (HTTP, an API, an MCP tool, a model)

words.label: runs
words.definition: starts another program and passes it arguments

words.label: routes
words.definition: chooses which script or handler does the work and hands it on

words.label: reads
words.definition: takes data out of a store, a file or a service

words.label: writes
words.definition: puts data into a store, a file or a service

words.label: watches
words.definition: is told when data changes, and reacts

words.label: stores
words.definition: keeps data for others to read later

words.label: queues
words.definition: carries messages from producers to consumers

words.label: decides
words.definition: evaluates a state machine or a decision tree and acts on its outcome

words.label: validates
words.definition: checks data against a schema before it is used

words.label: transforms
words.definition: reshapes or computes over data in memory
